SELECT shop_id shopId, shop_logo shopLogo, status, shop_detailed_address address, shop_title shopTitle, ( 6371000 * acos( cos(radians(#{query.latitude})) * cos(radians(shop_latitude)) * cos(radians(shop_longitude) - radians(#{query.longitude})) + sin(radians(#{query.latitude})) * sin(radians(shop_latitude)) ) ) AS distance, shop_longitude longitude, shop_latitude latitude, shop_contact_json contactJson, AS shopStar, shop_star_num shopStarNum, description description, shop_sales shopSales, shop_open_close_json shopOpenCloseConfigJson FROM shop WHERE shop_type = 2 AND ( status = 1 or status = 10)
AND shop_region_id like CONCAT('%', #{query.regionId}, '%')
AND shop_title like CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND shop_id IN
#{id}
AND (
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_local_delivery_config sldc WHERE sldc.shop_id = shop.shop_id AND sldc.enabled = 1 )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_home_service_config shsc WHERE shsc.shop_id = shop.shop_id AND shsc.enabled = 1 )
)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_local_delivery_config sldc WHERE sldc.shop_id = shop.shop_id AND sldc.enabled = 1 AND sldc.delivery_radius IS NOT NULL AND sldc.delivery_radius > 0 AND ( 6371000 * acos( cos(radians(#{query.latitude})) * cos(radians(shop.shop_latitude)) * cos(radians(shop.shop_longitude) - radians(#{query.longitude})) + sin(radians(#{query.latitude})) * sin(radians(shop.shop_latitude)) ) ) <= sldc.delivery_radius )
ORDER BY
shop_id = #{query.selectedShopId} DESC,
distance IS NULL, distance
shop_star
ASC DESC DESC

SELECT shop_id shopId, shop_logo shopLogo, status, shop_detailed_address address, shop_title shopTitle, shop_longitude longitude, shop_latitude latitude, shop_contact_json contactJson, AS shopStar, shop_star_num shopStarNum, description description, shop_sales shopSales, shop_open_close_json shopOpenCloseConfigJson FROM shop WHERE shop_type = 2 AND ( status = 1 or status = 10)
AND shop_region_id like CONCAT('%', #{query.regionId}, '%')
AND shop_title like CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND shop_id IN
#{id}
AND (
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_local_delivery_config sldc WHERE sldc.shop_id = shop.shop_id AND sldc.enabled = 1 )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_home_service_config shsc WHERE shsc.shop_id = shop.shop_id AND shsc.enabled = 1 )
)
ORDER BY
shop_id = #{query.selectedShopId} DESC,
shop_star
ASC DESC DESC

SELECT shop_id shopId, shop_title shopTitle, CASE WHEN #{query.latitude} IS NULL OR #{query.longitude} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (6371000 * acos( cos(radians(#{query.latitude})) * cos(radians(shop_latitude)) * cos(radians(shop_longitude) - radians(#{query.longitude})) + sin(radians(#{query.latitude})) * sin(radians(shop_latitude)) )) END AS distance, shop_longitude longitude, shop_latitude latitude, shop_contact_json contactJson, shop_open_close_json shopOpenCloseConfigJson, shop_region_id shopRegionIdsJson, shop_detailed_address address FROM shop WHERE shop_type = 3 AND status = 1 AND store_parent_id = #{query.shopId}
AND shop_region_id like CONCAT('%', #{query.regionId}, '%')
AND shop_detailed_address like CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query.latitude} IS NULL OR #{query.longitude} IS NULL THEN shop_id ELSE distance END ASC

SELECT shop_id shopId, shop_logo shopLogo, status, shop_detailed_address address, shop_title shopTitle, 0 AS distance, shop_longitude longitude, shop_latitude latitude, shop_contact_json contactJson, AS shopStar, shop_sales shopSales FROM shop s left join store_product sp on s.shop_id = sp.shop_id WHERE shop_type = 2 AND status = 1 AND shop_region_id like CONCAT('%', #{query.regionId}, '%')
AND shop_title like CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND sp.product_id = #{query.productId}
ORDER BY
distance
shop_star
ASC DESC DESC

SELECT shop.*, CASE WHEN #{query.latitude} IS NULL OR #{query.longitude} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (6371000 * acos( cos(radians(#{query.latitude})) * cos(radians(shop_latitude)) * cos(radians(shop_longitude) - radians(#{query.longitude})) + sin(radians(#{query.latitude})) * sin(radians(shop_latitude)) )) END AS distance FROM shop WHERE shop_type = 3 AND status = 1 AND store_parent_id = #{query.shopId} ORDER BY distance

SELECT shop_id, shop_title, add_time, shop_logo, click_count, status, merchant_id, shop_money, frozen_money, contact_mobile, description, kefu_phone, kefu_weixin, kefu_link, is_contact_kefu, kefu_inlet, ship_info, receive_info, last_login_time, vendor_set_price_type, vendor_set_price_auto_value, service_fee_rate, fee_rate, shop_type, store_parent_id, shop_cover_picture, shop_show_picture, shop_contact_json, shop_open_close_json, shop_region_id, shop_detailed_address, shop_longitude, shop_latitude, AS shop_star, shop_total_star, shop_star_num, shop_sales, use_shop_category, shop_show_category, auto_erase_zero, auto_deduction_points, default_collection_method, auto_add_cart_after_scan, auto_print_online_order, auto_print_offline_order, shop_common_remarks, pos_product_source FROM shop WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.shop_id FROM shop s LEFT JOIN translations_data t ON t.data_type = 2 AND t.data_id = s.shop_id AND t.locale_id = ( SELECT l.id FROM locales l WHERE l.locale_code = #{localeCode} LIMIT 1 ) WHERE t.translation_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
